reference: A High Contracting Party must submit a letter to the Director-General of UNESCO regarding objections to the inclusion of a cultural value in the Register within four months of sending a copy of the request for inclusion. This objection must be justified by specific reasons, such as the value not being a cultural value or the conditions outlined in Article 8 of the Convention not being met.
